_readme: Copied to demo.config.json (not committed) the first time you run pnpm demo. Edit demo.config.json, not this file. gate.lat/lng: where the phones will stand during the demo (long-press the spot in Google Maps to copy them). radiusM: how close a phone must be, 10-300 (indoor GPS is rough, so the demo default is generous). proxyPort: the one local port the tunnel exposes.
